title: Pre-flight Risk Matrix, Stakeholder Cadence, and Release Note Templates for API/Console/Runtime Release Train
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Create a lightweight, repeatable pre-flight package for the API/Console/Runtime release train that reduces launch friction and ambiguity. Deliverables: 1) a risk matrix mapping feature areas to cut criteria and mitigation steps, 2) a two-week stakeholder cadence (who signs off when), 3) templated release-note snippets for engineering, product, and legal that can be filled per-PR, and 4) a short communication runbook for GTM and Support (embargo windows, known issues, rollback bullets). This ticket synthesizes inputs from eng, design, docs, security, and GTM and produces the artifacts required by the release gate checklist.
acceptance_criteria: A risk matrix spreadsheet with severity, likelihood, owner, and automatic cut rule mapping (example: severity >= P0 && likelihood >= medium => scope lock).
A stakeholder cadence PDF showing signoff owners and expected signoff window (engineering, security, docs, legal, support, GTM).
Release-note snippet templates for 3 audiences: developer changelog, user-facing console notes, and enterprise compliance summary.
A brief runbook (one pager) for incident/rollback communications including SQL of where to publish and who pings customer success.
All artifacts linked in the release-train Confluence page and validated in a dry-run with one small rollout by 2026-03-18.

runbook_snippets: Embargo window: Documentation embargo opens 24h before GA candidate and closes 4h after GA; GTM embargo closes only after public announcement.

Rollback bullets: 1) Repoint traffic to previous compatible runtime image; 2) Re-enable prior model variant; 3) Notify Support and GTM channel with predefined template; 4) Open emergency postmortem link.
Communication channels: Slack #release-orchestration for live updates, PagerDuty for P0 incidents, and Confluence release page for status.
risks_and_mitigations: Kernel rollback complexity - Mitigation: keep last two kernel builds in rotation and rehearse rollback in staging (ENG-5973).
Telemetry schema drift - Mitigation: Add a compatibility shim and alert on missing fields; run end-to-end telemetry smoke before rollout.
Localization delay - Mitigation: Publish English notes first with 'localization in progress' banner; ensure Docs has priority localization pipeline.
